description:
Intern – E Network:

  • Gained understanding of how ERP systems manage business workflows, inventory, human resources, finance, and other internal operations.

  • Learned backend development using Node.js and Express.js, including creating APIs and handling server-side logic.

  • Worked with React.js and explored core features such as components, hooks, and UI development.

  • Learned state management using Redux, Redux Toolkit, and API integration techniques for managing application data efficiently.

  • Assisted in developing responsive web interfaces and improving application functionality through modern JavaScript technologies.

Capcon:

  • During my time at Capcon, I gained hands-on experience in web scraping and browser automation using Puppeteer. I developed scripts to extract product-related data from e-commerce clothing websites, including product names, prices, images, descriptions, and categories.

  • I worked with DOM manipulation, CSS selectors, and automated browser interactions to navigate dynamic web pages and collect structured data efficiently. This experience also helped me understand concepts such as asynchronous operations, handling dynamic content, data extraction workflows, and improving scraping reliability for different website structures.

DK Rucrement:

  • Worked on implementing lazy loading in React applications to improve initial page load performance and optimize component rendering.

  • Worked with Next.js features such as Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG) to enhance application performance and SEO.

  • Implemented authentication and session management using JSON Web Tokens (JWT) and cookies for secure user access.

  • Developed and maintained custom routers and controllers for efficient request handling and better code organization.

  • Managed file upload functionality using Multer for efficient file processing and storage handling.

MetaXols :

  • At MetaXols, I worked on building scalable web applications and AI-based systems using technologies such as Google Cloud, Supabase, Edge Functions, and serverless architectures. I contributed to backend development, cloud integrations, authentication systems, automation workflows, and AI model deployment.

  • I developed and maintained serverless APIs using Supabase Edge Functions and cloud services to handle authentication, database operations, real-time updates, and secure user interactions. I worked with authentication flows, JWT-based authorization, database queries, and role-based access systems to ensure secure access control and efficient data management.

  • I also implemented real-time functionality using Supabase subscriptions and event-driven features, enabling live updates for user interactions, notifications, and application data synchronization.

  • In AI-related projects, I worked on deploying and integrating AI modules using Supabase and cloud infrastructure. I deployed the WAN 2.0 model from Hugging Face on RunPod for AI-powered media generation workflows. This included handling GPU environments, model execution pipelines, API integrations, and media processing workflows.

  • Additionally, I worked with n8n to automate workflows, third-party integrations, notifications, and backend processes, helping improve development efficiency and reduce manual operational tasks.

  • Through this experience, I gained strong exposure to cloud infrastructure, serverless backend development, AI deployment workflows, API integrations, automation systems, and scalable application architecture.
